description:
Immemorabilis adds persistent notifications and fast task entry to Apple Reminders. Your lists stay in Reminders while Immemorabilis gives them another way to get your attention.

If you clear or ignore a notification, Immemorabilis can remind you again after 1, 2, 4, or 8 hours. Snooze a task for 15 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, or tomorrow. Notifications scheduled together can be spaced apart.

Add a reminder by typing or dictating it. Write dates and times naturally. Add notes, web links, locations, and repeat rules. Choose the Reminders lists you want to see in a Today and Tomorrow agenda.

Use it as a small to-do planner for research, teaching, work, or home. Voice entry is ready when your hands are busy, and the agenda shows what is due.

Widgets show upcoming tasks and let you add or dictate a reminder from the Home Screen.

Features:
• Apple Reminders and iCloud integration
• Persistent notifications
• Quick snooze and defer controls
• Natural-language dates and times
• Dictation
• Location reminders
• Recurring tasks
• Notes and web links
• Home Screen widgets
• Light and dark appearance
• Red and blue accent colors

Free and open source. No account, subscription, advertising, analytics, or AI training. Your reminders remain in Apple Reminders and iCloud.

Support and discussion are available through GitHub Issues.
promotionalText: Free and open source. Persistent notifications, quick snooze, dictation, location reminders, repeat rules, and widgets for Apple Reminders.
